title.narrative: Territorial Development through Resilient Livestock Systems and Market-Enabling Rural Infrastructure in Entre Ríos

description.narrative: The project's goal is to enable the effective participation of small-scale producers in local and national bioeconomy-related market-driven inclusive value chains. This to contribute to income generation, extending financial and non-financial services to the rural communities, creating more employment opportunities, and strengthening rural infrastructure to allow for better market access.
